reasons.emulator:
STATUS (2026-07-12): vWLC (AireOS) ships a 3.10.0 kernel that hits a
divide-error kernel panic in clockevents_config() under KVM
host-passthrough CPU mode - confirmed via live serial probe across
multiple releases (8.0.152/8.3.141/8.7.102). Pinning cpu_model away
from "host" (the platform default) avoids whatever host-passthrough
exposes that this old kernel's clock calibration can't handle -
qemu64 is the same conservative baseline this codebase already uses
for other legacy/32-bit-era guests.
disk_bus corrected virtio -> megasas (2026-09-01, NPX-154): the real runtime
bus comes from shared/image_profiles.py's disk_bus_for() table ("vwlc":
"megasas"), matching the actual shipped file name (megasasa.qcow2) - this
field only feeds the UI Inspector's displayed hardware-defaults dropdown, but
leaving it wrong here was a live footgun of the exact same class already
fixed once for "titanium" above (see that entry's own comment): a user who
edited a vWLC node's disk bus in the Inspector and saved would write
config.disk_bus="virtio", which DOES override the runtime default and would
attach the real megasas-formatted disk over the wrong controller.
config_dialect="aireos" (2026-09-01, NPX-154): AireOS is not IOS-family and
has no enable/config CLI - see node_config.py's VENDOR_CLI["aireos"] and
_dismiss_aireos_wizard() for the full live-verified writeup (real wizard
driven end to end, real save+reboot confirmed to skip the wizard on the next
boot, real login reaching "(Cisco Controller) >").
boot_timeout_sec raised 300 -> 480: the wizard alone is ~28 sequential
prompts: node_config.py's own _retry_deadline_s derives its console-exchange
budget from this field (minus an 80s margin), and 300 - 80 = 220s measured too
tight against the live probe's real wall-clock run (needed comfortably more
than that for boot + the full wizard + save + reboot + login).
reasons.qemu_version_default: rule #59 (2026-09-21, NPX-1266): Reverted to EVE-NG's pin (2.4.0). The old 2.12.0 was only a fallback from before QEMU 2.4.0 could be built (NPX-457/NPX-1139, built+lane-verified 2026-09-16); that reason no longer exists.
